title: Wakesplit Crystal Cluster
description: A three-metre cluster and opposing side growths erupt through a limestone shelf, leaving an open apron of bare earth.

review.notes: Round 2. Fixed: crystals are now directional hexagonal prisms with pyramidal tips (no more ellipsoids); limestone shelf is now layered plates with chipped edges and varied rubble; no black hole-like facets. Not fixed: (1) material is a flat, saturated light purple with vertical streaks; the brief asks for dark violet opaque gemstone with lighter facets and inner bands - darken the base, give each facet its own value, put the bands inside the crystal instead of on the surface. (2) The growth bands are raised outer collars at even spacing, so every prism reads like bamboo; replace them with uneven, inset growth steps and vary spacing per crystal. (3) Tips are all clean, perfect points; break or chip 2-3 terminations and add small secondary crystals at the base. (4) Emissive cracks are hair-thin and only visible on two crystals in the close-up; make 2-3 cracks per large crystal readable in the hero shot while keeping emission restrained.
